title: Zak R NDE 8424
content: I had a stroke on June 2, 2010 which affected the left side of my body. This caused me to bewheelchair bound. Later, I was admitted to hospital with uncontrollably high blood pressure. After a series of tests, it was determined that I had a block in my right kidney tubule so I was scheduled for surgery to remove the blockage. At about 7 am on the day before the surgery, my wife took me to the bathroom and then I had the experience. I was hovering above my body and focused on my wife. She was running around frantically and I was wondering why the next next thing I know was waking up from my bed. My wife my twin soul I love her very dearly then and now. I was later told by the hospital authorities that I was proclaimed clinically dead for 2 minutes. The next day, I was taken to surgery as scheduled. At the surgery table, the doctor discovered that the kidney blockage I had previous was gone. So, I did not have the surgery. In addition, the surgeon told me I have 2 kidney tubules on each side. I wonder if I got it during the experience or before I am curious. However, the experience validated my teachings and realization of the Continuity of Consciousness. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: Approximately, November 2010 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain. Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) How do you consider the content of your experience? Neither pleasant NOR distressing The experience included: Out of body experience Did you feel separated from your body? No How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness. My level of Consciousness was same. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? At all times to the best of my knowledge and realization. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Vision appeared the same. I really don't know because my focus was on my wife. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I didn't hear anything Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an Unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Worried about my wife. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? No Did you have a feeling of joy? No Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? No Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What importance did you place on your religious/spiritual life prior to your experience? Greatly important to me What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Catholic Even though Catholic, I was also a member of the Rosicrucian Order Amorc from 1990 and also attained the higher degrees. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I do more meditation. What importance do you place on your religious/spiritual life after your experience? Greatly important to me What is your religion now? Christian- Catholic Still a member of Amorc. In addition, I am also an ARE member since April 2017 and eager to be of service for humanity. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. The experience validated my belief of continuation of Consciousness before and after the experience. In fact I believe that the experience was a test to prove that my belief was right. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No experience Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No Did you believe in the existence of God prior to your experience? God definitely exists During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Do you believe in the existence of God after your experience? God definitely exists Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Did you believe that our earthly lives Are meaningful and significant prior to your experience? Are probably meaningful and significant During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No Did you believe in an afterlife prior to your experience? An afterlife definitely exists Do you believe in an afterlife after your experience? An afterlife definitely exists No Did you fear death prior to your experience? I moderately feared death Do you fear death after your experience? I do not fear death Were you fearful living your life prior to your experience? Moderately fearful in living my earthly life Were you fearful living your life after your experience? Not fearful in living my earthly life Did you believe that our earthly lives Are meaningful and significant prior to your experience? Are probably meaningful and significant Did you believe that our earthly lives are meaningful and significant after your experience? Are meaningful and significant Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No Were you compassionate prior to your experience? Moderately compassionate toward others During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes That I loved my wife very dearly as always. Were you compassionate after your experience? Greatly compassionate toward others What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life. This was validation of my belief in the Continuity of Consciousness. Communication with past masters inclusive of Jesus, Mother Mary, and even Edgar Cayce who directed me to join the ARE. About May 2014, I started receiving instructions for several future scientific discoveries and also instructions to protect it from predators. Edgar Casey with who I'm in communication with on a daily basis, I call fondly Brother Casey and he seems to like it. I also joked with my friends specially with my closest friend also a Physician. When his brother-in-law passed and he was distraught I told him. 'Hey Roger don't worry, Ron is in the right place I know because I have connections in high places.' Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes I was solely focused on my wife. I had no other thoughts. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. About the same. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes Communication with past masters and inspirations of inventions and scientific discoveries. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Continuity of Consciousness because I can remember everything during the experience as continuation Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Yes with close friends and relatives some were skeptical and others were receptive. On October 10, 2015, I shared it publicly in a prayer gathering at our church. It is also on Utube which you can access with the Utube id Mother of Health and Storms this program greatly reached a lot of people who knew me earlier. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes Our own daughter had a fall from the second floor our apartment. She was in a comatose condition for a couple of days and was completely fine by Divine intervention. As a 3-years old child she tole me that, 'Blessed Mother and baby Jesus will visit me tonight and I will be ok.' She was fine and discharged from the hospital the next morning without leaving a trace of the devastating fall. Today, our daughter is Doctor on her way to specialize in nuerology. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. I believed because of my training and because my the person I trust most told me. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real .At best currently I believe that was like an Out of body experience (OBE) At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Yes my wife said that I came back when the hospital were preparing to apply the defibrillator. In addition to the kidney blockage, I had a 60 percent block in my left carotid which was cleared a few weeks after the experience. Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? Currently I don't see any.

demographics.religious_background_detail: Catholic; also member of Rosicrucian Order AMORC (since 1990) and ARE member (since April 2017).

diagnosis.diagnosis_raw: Stroke (June 2, 2010) affecting left side; later admitted with uncontrollably high blood pressure; testing found a block in right kidney tubule; later mentions 60% block in left carotid.
diagnosis.disease_name: Stroke with left-sided impairment; severe hypertension; right kidney tubule blockage; left carotid artery stenosis (60%)
diagnosis.severity_description: Wheelchair bound after stroke; clinically dead for 2 minutes (per hospital authorities); uncontrollably high blood pressure.
diagnosis.quality_of_life_impact: Wheelchair bound due to left-sided deficits after stroke.
diagnosis.vascular_condition: Uncontrollably high blood pressure; 60% block in left carotid (cleared a few weeks after the experience).

treatment.treatments_raw: Scheduled surgery to remove right kidney tubule blockage (ultimately not performed because blockage was gone). Later the 60% left carotid block was 'cleared a few weeks after the experience' (method not stated).
treatment.surgery_type: Planned surgery to remove right kidney tubule blockage (cancelled intraoperatively / prior to proceeding).
treatment.surgery_outcome: Not performed because surgeon discovered blockage was gone.
treatment.treatment_stopped_reason: Surgery cancelled because blockage was no longer present.

remission_outcome.time_to_remission_raw: By the next day (day of scheduled surgery), the kidney blockage was gone.
remission_outcome.verification_detail: At the surgery table, the doctor discovered the previously identified right kidney tubule blockage was gone; surgery was not performed. Hospital authorities reportedly stated he was clinically dead for 2 minutes.

turner_factors.spiritual_practices_raw: Catholic faith; more meditation after the experience; shared publicly at a church prayer gathering.
turner_factors.purpose_details: He reports being eager to be of service for humanity and receiving instructions for future scientific discoveries.

existential_shift.transformation_narrative: He reports no longer fearing death after the experience and increased compassion; he describes the event as validation of the continuity of consciousness.
existential_shift.pivot_point_description: The reported clinical death/OBE episode preceding discovery that the kidney blockage was gone.
major_life_changes: Publicly shared the experience at a church prayer gathering (Oct 10, 2015)
Joined ARE (April 2017) after reported communications with Edgar Cayce

anomalous_experience.experience_description: Out-of-body experience hovering above his body, focused on his wife while she ran around frantically; later told he was clinically dead for 2 minutes.
anomalous_experience.experience_timing: Morning (~7am) the day before scheduled kidney surgery; stroke occurred June 2, 2010; NDE date also stated as approximately November 2010 (inconsistency).

validation.statistical_improbability_notes: Right kidney tubule blockage reportedly resolved by the next day after being scheduled for surgical removal; limited objective documentation (no imaging/lab specifics provided).
validation.extraction_notes: Key inconsistency: NDE is described as occurring the day before scheduled kidney surgery after a June 2, 2010 stroke, but the form field lists NDE date as approximately November 2010. Method of 'clearing' 60% left carotid blockage is not specified.

analysis.case_summary: Male patient had a stroke (June 2, 2010) with left-sided impairment and later was hospitalized with severe hypertension and a diagnosed right kidney tubule blockage scheduled for surgery. After a reported NDE/OBE with 2 minutes of clinical death, the next day the surgeon found the kidney blockage had resolved and surgery was cancelled; he later also reports a 60% left carotid blockage cleared weeks later.
key_healing_factors: Reported NDE/OBE with brief clinical death preceding discovery that kidney blockage was gone
Strong spiritual framework (Catholic) with increased meditation afterward
Reduced fear of death after the experience
unique_features: Anomalous resolution of a planned-surgery kidney tubule blockage by the next day
Reports anatomical variant: two kidney tubules on each side (as told by surgeon)
Reports ongoing communications with 'past masters' (including Edgar Cayce) after the NDE
analysis.analysis_notes: This is not a cancer remission case; it is primarily cardiovascular/renal obstruction with an anomalous perioperative finding. Verification relies on self-report of physician discovery; no imaging, reports, or named clinicians are provided.
